test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the maximum amount of home loan the eligible beneficiaries can get under the 'Mo Ghara' scheme launched by the Government of Odisha in May 2023?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Upto ₹3 lakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **'Mo Ghara'** scheme was launched by the **Government of Odisha** in **May 2023**.
 
• This scheme is aimed at providing financial support to the **eligible beneficiaries** for the construction and improvement of their houses.
 
• Under this scheme, the beneficiaries can avail of a home loan of **up to ₹3 lakh**.
 
• The scheme targets the **weaker sections** of society, including **economically weaker sections (EWS)** and **low-income groups (LIG)**.
 
• The initiative is part of the state government’s efforts to ensure **housing for all** and improve the living conditions of its citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Eligible beneficiaries**__

 __
 
• These include families belonging to the **economically weaker sections (EWS)** and **low-income groups (LIG)**.
 
• The scheme aims to support the **construction and improvement of houses** to ensure better living conditions.
 
 
 
• **Housing for all**__
 
 
• The scheme aligns with the broader goal of achieving **housing for all** by providing financial support to the needy sections of society.
 
• This initiative is part of the state’s commitment to improving the **living standards** of its residents.
